title: Daniel Jones & Tomasz Maj - More software, faster - Odevo's AI Native transformation - AI DevCon '26
description:
How did Sweden's third-largest tech company, Odevo, transition to AI-native operations? Transforming an organization isn't just about training and licenses. It sounds simple. It isn't. Discover the real forces behind their shift, from outdated tech stacks to the challenges of local practices and unforeseeable growing pains. Odevo's journey offers a pragmatic lens into what's required to truly become AI native. 

Daniel Jones and Tomasz Maj are at the helm of this conversation. Daniel is a head of product at re:cinq and Tomasz is a a former McKinsey consultant and head of product ops at odevo, specializing in AI-native transformations. They bring firsthand experiences from the trenches of Odevo's unique transformation, blending technical insight with real-world application to share what worked, what failed, and where Odevo is heading with AI.

What we cover:
• The complexities behind Odevo's transition to AI-native operations
• How did agentic coding change Odevo's software development?
• What challenges did Odevo face with legacy tech during its AI adoption?
• Why was a uniform AI training approach crucial for Odevo's developers?
• The measurable impact on Odevo's productivity and growth since embracing AI
